summary: IQVIA Inc., a wholly owned subsidiary of IQVIA Holdings Inc., filed an 8-K on September 23, 2026, disclosing the issuance of $2.0 billion of 6.375% senior unsecured notes due March 15, 2034. Net proceeds will redeem its 5.000% senior notes due 2026, repay revolver borrowings, and cover fees. Interest is payable semi-annually. The notes are guaranteed by certain subsidiaries. This is a routine refinancing, not a special situation. Watch for any change in leverage or redemption terms.
